model_annotation: The plot illustrates training loss as a function of iteration for six model variants, allowing their loss trajectories to be viewed on the same axes. The x-axis is labeled “#Iteration” and uses a linear scale spanning from 0 to 140,000, with regularly spaced tick labels every 20,000 iterations. The y-axis is labeled “Loss” on a linear scale ranging from 2.4 to 3.4, with tick labels at 0.1 intervals. All series are drawn as solid lines with no visible point markers: the “Vanilla” curve is purple and drops steeply from about 3.35 at the start to roughly 2.65 by ~20,000 iterations, then declines gradually to about 2.47–2.48 near 140,000; “StrmLLM (n=64)” is dark blue and decreases from about 3.35 initially to around 2.82 near ~20,000, then continues downward more gradually to roughly 2.61 at ~140,000; “SepLLM (n=64)” is orange and falls from about 3.35 to approximately 2.69–2.70 by ~20,000, then trends down to around 2.52 by ~140,000; “SepLLM (n=64, H)” is green and follows a similar pattern, moving from about 3.35 at the start to roughly 2.68–2.69 near ~20,000 and ending near about 2.52 at ~140,000; “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)” is red and declines from about 3.35 to approximately 2.67–2.68 by ~20,000 before gradually reaching around 2.50–2.51 near 140,000; and “SepLLM (n=128)” is shown as a second blue-toned line (lighter blue), dropping from about 3.35 at the beginning to around 2.66–2.67 near ~20,000 and tapering to roughly 2.49–2.50 by ~140,000.
